description: This file defines interfaces for managing process containers within the WPEFramework, including classes for container iteration, network interface details, memory and CPU info, and a container administrator singleton.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: An interface for iterating network interfaces of a container, providing functions to get interface name, address count, and specific addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Provides memory usage statistics such as allocated, resident, and shared memory in bytes.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Provides CPU usage metrics including total usage, per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator over container IDs, used to list containers managed by the framework.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a process container, providing access to container properties, status, resource usage, network interfaces, and control methods (start and stop).

classes.name: IContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton interface for managing container creation, retrieval, listing, and logging configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified id, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified global log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over all container IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, returns nullptr if not found.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
